curve_evolution.note: Full listed 3M Euribor strip (24 contracts through 2032-09). Later deliveries have shorter history; the amber line skips missing points.

ecb_meeting_pricing.note: Approximate meeting path from ICE 3M Euribor futures (not ECB-dated OIS / WIRP). Each meeting maps to the next quarterly contract after the decision as a post-meeting rate proxy. Probabilities assume 25bp steps. 3M Euribor is an unsecured term fixing and usually sits above the ECB deposit facility — use Bloomberg WIRP for precise per-meeting OIS pricing.
